security_probation_001.evidence: 1.2 Provisional Contract Teacher shall mean all regularly assigned teachers working half-time or more each day who have not yet completed three continuous years of contract employment as a teacher in Granite School District. 1.3 Regular Contract Teacher shall mean all regularly assigned teachers (except specially funded program teachers), working half-time or more each day, and who have completed the provisional period described above. 1.4 Temporary Teacher shall mean all teachers who are employed after the first day of the second semester and all other teachers hired on a limited short-term basis.

security_nonrenewal_002.evidence: 19.5.1 Preliminary Notice: When the District intends not to renew a teacher's contract, the District will inform the teacher of the fact that continued employment is in question and of the reasons thereof at least one month before issuing the nonrenewal notice. 19.5.2 Nonrenewal Notice: ... Nonrenewal notices will be delivered or mailed at least two months prior to the end of the contract term ... 19.7.1 After receiving a termination notice, or a nonrenewal notice, regular contract teachers ... may file a written request ... for a formal hearing to review the proposed dismissal. 19.7.3 At the hearing, the parties shall have the right to be accompanied, advised or represented ... produce witnesses, hear all testimony of the other party, cross-examine witnesses, and examine all documentary evidence. 19.7.4 Within ten calendar days following the hearing, the hearing examiner will submit his or her recommended solution to the Board...
security_nonrenewal_002.coder_notes: Updated evidence to Article 19, which explicitly outlines nonrenewal notice timelines and formal hearing/appeal procedures for regular contract teachers, providing a more direct and comprehensive basis for the 'yes' answer compared to the original passage which only addressed specially funded program teachers.

security_seniority_definition_003.evidence: 1.11 Seniority shall mean length of continuous and current employment as a teacher under contract in the District.

security_voluntary_transfer_004.answer: Teachers apply via written request to HR between April 1 and June 1 (or Summer form by June 15). Deadline is the fifth calendar date after posting. Selection prioritizes qualifications, then current district employment, then seniority (length of continuous service). Notify within 10 days; non-approved applicants may request reason and interview with HR director.
security_voluntary_transfer_004.evidence: 16.2.1 Between April 1 and June 1 each year, all teachers in the District shall be eligible to apply for transfer to any specific position in another school that has been posted as a vacancy for the following school year... 16.2.3 The application deadline date shall be the fifth calendar date following publication and posting of the vacancy... 16.3.2 Selection among applicants to fill posted vacancies shall be based on the relative qualifications of the applicants... 16.3.3 If the principal determines that two or more applicants are equally well qualified... first consideration shall be given to applicants who are currently employed by the District. 16.3.4 If a choice must be made among applicants currently employed... who have been determined... to be equally well qualified... the teacher with the greatest length of continuous and current contract service in the District shall be appointed. 16.3.6 Each approved transferee... shall be notified of the transfer within ten days after the application deadline. In the event a transfer is not approved, the applicant may request written notice of the reason. If a teacher has questions... the teacher may request an interview with the director of Human Resources...

security_involuntary_transfer_005.evidence: 16.6.2 Before recommending a teacher transfer, the principal and/or the appropriate School Accountability Services administrator will meet with the teacher involved to discuss the proposed transfer and the reasons thereof. 16.6.3 No administrative transfer will be made arbitrarily, capriciously, or without a written explanation of the reason for the transfer. 16.6.5 If the teacher objects to the proposed transfer, the teacher may request a meeting with the appropriate School Accountability Services administrator to discuss the matter. 16.6.6 Administrative transfers will be recommended by the principal and/or the appropriate School Accountability Services administrator, and will take effect only after approval by the appropriate Assistant Superintendent.

security_rif_006.answer: Surplus/RIF occurs due to enrollment decline, school closure, or program change. A call for volunteers is made first; if none, surplus is determined by program needs and qualifications, with least seniority as a tie-breaker. Requires written explanation, principal-teacher conference, and Superintendent approval. Written notice by April 1 (elementary) or April 20 (secondary).
security_rif_006.evidence: 16.4.1 Transfers of surplus teachers may become necessary at the end of the school year because of enrollment decline, school closure, or change in school program. 16.4.2 When... makes necessary the transfer of surplus teachers, a call for volunteers shall be made. If there are no volunteers, decisions as to which teachers will be declared surplus shall be based on the program and staffing needs of the school, and the relative qualifications of the teaching staff... 16.4.3 If a choice must be made between two or more teachers... equally well qualified... the teacher with the least seniority in the District will be declared surplus. 16.4.4 No teacher will be declared surplus without an explanation of the reasons... Before recommending that a teacher be declared surplus, the principal will confer with the teacher involved... 16.4.5... will be recommended by the principal and the appropriate School Accountability Services administrator and will be effected only after approval by the Superintendent. 16.5.1 Written notice of surplus status will be given, when possible, by April 1 for elementary teachers and by April 20 for secondary teachers.
